cohort: The study included 312 pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: The 12-hour comprehensive nutrition care (12h-HNC) intervention significantly lowered maternal 2-h postprandial glucose levels, reduced maternal weight gain, and decreased neonatal birth weight and incidence of macrosomia in women with GDM compared to traditional nutrition guidance.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section was similar between the 12h-HNC group and the control group.
